in_sanskrit.name: Enjansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Hills
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Enjansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Enjansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Enjan', which means 'Lord of the Hills'. This name is often given to children born in hilly regions or to those who are believed to have a strong connection with the mountains.
